# Repository instructions

Read and follow the root `AGENTS.md` for every coding task.

In particular, shipped plugin or CLI behavior changes require a `VERSION` bump
and a matching `## <version>` section in `CHANGELOG.md` in the same task, before
building deliverables. Use a patch bump for fixes unless instructed otherwise.
Do not finish a behavior change with only an `Unreleased` changelog entry.
Follow-up edits to the same unpublished release reuse its version.
